entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Langversion default not respected with net10 sdk installed #81189
  • Formatter seems to mess up line endings for automatically added imports when original file is positional record #81186
  • Deprecate RoslynCompilerType=Framework #81184
    18.3
  • Renaming is not supported on parameter type in extension definition without parameter name #81181
  • Internal extension property + InternalsVisibleTo triggers CS0570 (not supported by the language) in consumer assembly #81180
    18.3
  • Debug assert in NullableWalker when opening project with MS.CA.LanguageServer #81175
    18.3
  • Pattern matching emits invalid IL when input type is a value type and extension Deconstruct's `this` parameter is a reference type #81173
    18.3
  • .NET 10 - C# compiler "error" in VS debugger. #81171
    18.3
  • Assembly loading fails for Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.resources with Culture=neutral on non-English systems #81168

  • if block not indented after else #16328
    Backlog
